Lcious – Boysenberry & Cream Scone 100ml
Lcious is Australia’s hottest new small-batch, artisan brand creating only the richest, and most authentic dessert e-liquids.
A delightful combination of the sweet and tart flavour of boysenberries with the richness of cream.
The result is a well-balanced and flavourful taste that combines the fruity essence of boysenberries with the creamy goodness, creating a delightful contrast.
